issues.quote: That is the only hour I can give you with any confidence.
issues.fact: O4 states only that the hall clock struck eleven a moment after he came back. It says nothing about her confidence in any reading.
issues.misreading: A careful solver could read this as a warning that her other readings, including the temple's ten o'clock strike and the watch readings, are unreliable. That would change how much weight the ten and nine readings carry, which the fact sheet presents as certain.

issues.quote: I played Chopin until he came back
issues.fact: O3 says only that she played the piano until he came back and stopped when he came in. The fact sheet gives no piece of music.
issues.misreading: The invented detail does not change any clock reading or duration, so it is awkward rather than misleading.
